data.description:
# Gate blindness to world-grounded evidence: force measurement provenance into the record

## Context / Problem

A `/rebar-implement` run of epic `061c-ecd1-8967-4a76` landed five changes through every gate. **The gates
performed to their design envelope.** Plan-review blocked infeasible mechanics (a tenacity-transport claim that
cannot wrap boto3; an `isinstance` against a botocore-dependent class; a live canary path that would have made
billable AWS calls on every CI run). The completion-verifier twice refused a close whose stated criteria had no
test. Full-suite pre-flight caught cross-module regressions `tests/unit` missed.

Every one of those catches shares a property: **the ground truth lived in the repo**, where the reviewer's
read/grep tools could reach it.

Four escapes got through, and they are one defect wearing different clothes — **a green signal whose
measurement could not have observed the failure it claims to rule out**:

1. **Wrong environment.** Bedrock caching and model-availability measurements were taken in account
   `579718921998` / `us-east-2` and recorded as settled fact; the project runs in `896586841071` / `us-east-1`
   (named by the Terraform backend `rebar-tfstate-896586841071`). No gate compares a claim's observation
   context against the project's environment. A human caught it by asking "is that this project's account?"
2. **Privilege that cannot fail.** Live `bedrock:Converse` calls validated a *scoped* IAM grant while running
   under an identity holding `bedrock:*`. Evidence generated under broader privilege than production is
   structurally unable to fail, so its success carries **zero information**. Role-scoped
   `simulate-principal-policy` later proved the planned grant would have `implicitDeny`-ed in production —
   feeding `eb6e-f43a-e86b-443a`, a cutover with no fallback.
3. **Tests that cannot fail** — the code-side form of the same defect: a contrast case whose discriminating
   conjunct was never exercised, and an oracle asserting on an object where production passes a string.
   **Both WERE caught** (mutation testing; the LLM reviewer) precisely because they are repo-checkable. That
   contrast is the evidence for this epic's thesis.
4. **Confidence outrunning method**: "verified by reading" was a hand-picked grep that missed a dependency;
   "18/18 green" was reported while typecheck was red.

## Why 1 and 2 are structural, not a calibration miss

`verified_at_sha` pins the code world completely and the outside world not at all. Plan-review runs **before**
the evidence exists, so it cannot audit a measurement not yet taken; the completion-verifier accepts
`[operator-attested]` evidence **on trust by design** (ADR-0043). One gate cannot audit it, the other is
designed not to. The in-flight T5c rewrite pushes grounding toward current code and IaC state but still cannot
observe a live cloud account — nothing in the current design can, and nothing should try.

## Approach

Do **not** make a gate observe the world. Force the measurement's context into the record as text, then let the
existing repo-grounded machinery find contradictions in it. Detail lives in the child story; the shape is:

1. Extend the attested-evidence contract with measurement-provenance fields — environment, principal, and
   privilege posture relative to production.
2. Enforce their **presence** deterministically, zero LLM, mirroring
   `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_operator_attested.py` (DET-first doctrine).
3. Let an LLM criterion judge the *declaration* against repo facts — once provenance is text, "plan attests
   account X, IaC names account Y" becomes a **repo-checkable contradiction**, which is exactly what the
   gate's strongest criteria already do well.
4. Land the generalized rule as an **advisory** criterion per ADR-0054; corpus replay decides promotion.

## Explicitly rejected

- **Making the completion-verifier re-run world measurements.** Expensive, flaky, recursive — the verifier's
  own credentials carry the same privilege-masking problem, so it would validate using the instrument under
  suspicion.
- **Escape 4 as gate scope.** Reported-green-while-red is *reporting discipline*, already covered by the
  orchestration rule that agents report gate output faithfully rather than narrating success. Filing it as a
  gate gap would be mis-attribution.
- **Wording changes alone.** The contract was followed and still failed; emphasis is not the defect. This is
  the same lesson as epic `9109-2ad9-2477-4cf6` (Serena tool-choice), which is why that epic's structural
  framing is the model here rather than its subject matter.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] an `[operator-attested]` criterion lacking measurement provenance is flagged by a DETERMINISTIC check
      (no LLM), and the wrong-account escape is reproduced as a regression fixture from the real
      `579718921998` vs `896586841071` case
- [ ] the new criterion ships **advisory** (ADR-0054) and rides the `.rebar/` project overlay, leaving the
      shipped default criteria set unchanged for other rebar clients
- [ ] an ADR records the amended evidence contract, citing ADR-0043 as the shape it changes
- [ ] the completion-verifier is NOT made to re-run world measurements — the rejected alternative stays
      rejected, and a test or grep demonstrates it
data.title: Gate blindness to world-grounded evidence: force measurement provenance into the record
